sources.title: RFC 2131 — Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol
sources.author: IETF
sources.content: DHCP provides configuration parameters to Internet hosts and allocates reusable network addresses. Clients and servers exchange discover, offer, request, and acknowledgment messages, and relay agents can forward messages across subnet boundaries.

sources.title: Bruce Hartpence — RIT Directory
sources.author: Rochester Institute of Technology
sources.content: Bruce Hartpence teaches routing and switching, network services, and large-scale networking, with interests including DHCP, DNS, voice over IP, network security, and machine learning.
